welcome to My Baseplate. made by FurryBoy

Chat commands:
Prefix: -

-re • Respawns your character
-gr • Same as re i think
-rs • Refreshes your character
-rj • Makes you rejoin
-gh 1,2,3 or 1 2 3 • Spawn accessories to your character corresponding with the id's seperated by commas or spaces
-net • Enables net (server-side fe net)
-r6 • Refreshes you as R6
-r15 • Refreshes you as R15

Missing commands:
-pd • Enables permanent death, to disable just do -re or -rs to be refreshed (TO BE ADDED SOON)

Basically same as 'Just a baseplate.' just og type.
